proof_scope: Ask browser submit preflight rejects WebGPT-incompatible zip bundles before Tau DAG dispatch, preserving review context instead of encouraging manual file drops.

claims.proves: Over-limit zip attachments are rejected by the Ask preflight script and by the tau-dag browser entrypoint before a DAG receipt is produced.
claims.does_not_prove: Live browser provider availability, semantic review quality, or that a user-built replacement bundle contains every omitted source byte.

cases.name: webgpt-zip-over-limit-preflight-direct
command:
set -euo pipefail; cd ..; tmp=$(mktemp -d); python3 - <<'PY' "$tmp"
import sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
with zipfile.ZipFile(root/'six.zip','w') as zf:
    for i in range(6):
        zf.writestr(f'file-{i}.txt', 'payload\n')
PY
set +e; python3 scripts/browser_prompt_preflight.py --prompt 'review bundle' "$tmp/six.zip" >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err"; rc=$?; set -e; test "$rc" -eq 2; grep -q 'zip contains 6 files; maximum is 5' "$tmp/err"; grep -q 'Do not drop context' "$tmp/err"; echo ASK_ZIP_PREFLIGHT_DIRECT_PASS
cases.proves: The reusable browser_prompt_preflight boundary fails closed on a WebGPT-incompatible zip and tells the caller not to drop context.

cases.name: webgpt-zip-over-limit-blocks-tau-before-dag
command:
set -euo pipefail; cd ..; tmp=$(mktemp -d); python3 - <<'PY' "$tmp"
import sys, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
with zipfile.ZipFile(root/'six.zip','w') as zf:
    for i in range(6):
        zf.writestr(f'file-{i}.txt', 'payload\n')
PY
set +e; ./run.sh tau-dag 'Review the attached bundle.' --repo grahama1970/agent-skills --target preflight-zip-overlimit --immutable-goal 'Reject over-limit browser attachment before DAG dispatch.' --handler webgpt --attach-file "$tmp/six.zip" --execute --json --run-output-root "$tmp/out" >"$tmp/cli.out" 2>"$tmp/cli.err"; rc=$?; set -e; test "$rc" -eq 2; grep -q 'zip contains 6 files; maximum is 5' "$tmp/cli.err"; if find "$tmp/out" -name dag-receipt.json -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo UNEXPECTED_DAG_RECEIPT; exit 1; fi; echo ASK_ZIP_PREFLIGHT_CLI_PASS
cases.proves: The public Ask tau-dag browser entrypoint rejects the incompatible zip before Tau dispatch writes a DAG receipt.
